entry.summary:
In part three of this video series, Matthew Ames talks about waking from an induced coma and having his wife Diane share the news that his limbs had been amputated to save his life. 

Matthew and his wife Diane felt well supported by his healthcare team that day, and during his recovery and rehabilitation.
